mostWorthwhile.text: Returning the stream to the sea closed the water cycle clearly, linking evaporation, rain and runoff.

leastWorthwhile.text: Preparing the still pool felt like a predictable prerequisite rather than a meaningful decision, though it set the scene.

surprise.text: The explanation that moonlight is reflected sunlight, rather than lingering heat from formation, was a useful clarification.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt purposeless, though the pool preparation was the only offered gameplay action, so it involved little choice.

continue.text: Yes. The water cycle’s physical connections and the quiet final image made me curious to see another chapter.
